pages.text: Naaman was a brave army captain, but he had a skin sickness. A servant said, "The prophet Elisha can help you." So Naaman set out to find him.
Naaman came to Elisha's house. Elisha did not come out. He sent a message: "Go and wash in the Jordan River seven times."
Naaman was angry. "I thought Elisha would wave his hand!" But his servants said, "If he had asked you to do something hard, you would have done it. Why not try?"
Naaman washed seven times. His skin became healthy and new! He said, "Now I know there is a God in Israel."

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Naaman almost missed his healing because the way seemed too simple. God's ways can be simple, and we can trust them.
